en.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2 Officially Hits Netflix in October 2026
en.summary: Get ready to dive back into Night City's neon-drenched chaos. Netflix has confirmed the return of the beloved anime adaptation with a brand-new story and characters.
en.body:
The wait for more **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners** is officially nearing its end. Netflix has slated the highly anticipated second season for a global release on October 20, 2026. This marks a significant return for the **Studio Trigger** and **CD Projekt Red** collaboration, which captivated audiences four years ago with its heartbreaking tale of David Martinez and his crew of edgerunners.

While the original season delivered a powerful, self-contained narrative, fans have been clamoring for more. However, Season 2 will not revisit the fates of **David** or **Lucy**. Instead, viewers will be introduced to an entirely new ensemble of characters, promising a fresh perspective on the unforgiving sprawl of Night City. The synopsis teases the return of familiar themes: intense action, desperate survival, and the ever-present corporate machinations that define this dystopian future. The new season will focus on **Weak**, a washed-up cyberpunk legend navigating a world that has left him behind without his chrome, and the vengeful nomad **D**, whose quest for retribution unearths dangerous corporate secrets.

This approach to continuing the series is a bold move, signaling an intent to explore the vast potential of the **Cyberpunk** universe. By introducing a new cast, **Studio Trigger** can craft a standalone story that resonates with the core spirit of **Edgerunners** without being beholden to the previous characters' arcs. This allows for fresh emotional stakes and new ways to break our hearts, a hallmark of the original series' success. The 10-episode season, each running approximately 25 minutes, will delve into themes of family, obsession, and legacy, ensuring that even with new faces, the emotional core remains intact.

## A New Generation of Night City's Finest

The community's reaction to the news has been a mix of elation and cautious optimism. The original **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners** was lauded as one of the best video game adaptations ever made, praised for its stunning animation, gripping narrative, and raw emotional impact. The announcement of a new cast has sparked considerable discussion online, with fans eager to see how the creative team will capture lightning in a bottle once more. Will this new story capture the same magic that made David and Lucy's journey so unforgettable? The success of this new direction hinges on **Studio Trigger's** ability to craft compelling new protagonists and a narrative that feels both fresh and authentic to the **Cyberpunk** world.

## What's Next

With **Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Season 2** set to premiere on October 20, 2026, fans have ample time to rewatch the first season or even dive into **Cyberpunk 2077** and its **Phantom Liberty** expansion to fully immerse themselves in Night City. Details regarding the full voice cast, beyond the initial mentions of **Koki Uchiyama**, **Momoka Terasawa**, **Kentaro Tone**, and **Akari Kitō**, have not yet been announced.
